evals.name: dispatch-fe-be-ticket-claude-main
evals.prompt: ok dispatch THV-862 into a pane, its the copy a catalog piece to a student slice for materials v3. you're main in claude code, I'm in herdr pane w18:p59. go
evals.expected_output: Tier 2, launched by scripts/dispatch spawn --tier 2 (CLI, model, effort and permission flag from agents.toml, none hand-typed), a filled brief pointing at the ticket with Thoven moment skills, tab labelled for the issue, the opening prompt sent by dispatch spawn (no hand-typed herdr agent prompt), Linear to In Progress, dispatch watch armed.

evals.name: stale-pane-overloaded
evals.prompt: the THV-862 pane went quiet like 20 min ago and nothing came back to you. what's going on, handle it. screen is in fixtures/stale-pane-screen.txt
evals.expected_output: Classifies as a provider overload error with the turn ended and no status line; waits then sends continue or restarts in same pane with last commit 4e1a9c2; asks for status line; one plain line to Andres; re-arms watcher; does not resend the whole brief blindly or mark anything done.

evals.name: dispatch-hard-backend-codex-main
evals.prompt: you're running as main in codex cli this time. THV-859 needs to go out, catalog schema + mutopia import, it's gnarly. set it up
evals.expected_output: Tier 1 from agents.py launch-line 1 whatever CLI main runs in, that CLI's skill prefix in the brief, Rails and migration skills at their moments, brief filled from the ticket.

evals.name: done-report-verify-and-close
evals.prompt: THV-862 pane just reported back, see fixtures/done-report.txt. take it from here
evals.expected_output: Leaves the ticket In Progress until the PR opens (Linear then sets In Review; not Done), runs working-if checks, opens a fresh tier-2 verifier pane (not the builder pane) with the verifier brief, flags the inferred acceptance line 3 for real evidence, waits for Andres before Done, files the StudentSelect empty state as a follow-up at close.

evals.name: labels-research-dispatch-and-main
evals.prompt: first dispatch in the COPPA space: send THV-1050 to a pane. it's a research ticket, compare how three vendors store consent evidence, no code. you're main in claude code, I'm in herdr pane w40:p1.
evals.expected_output: Labels main with scripts/dispatch label $HERDR_PANE_ID Meta "COPPA and Data Compliance Audit" --tab and spawns the new pane with dispatch spawn --kind Research, never Build for a research ticket. Brief carries the status line. No hand-typed herdr pane rename.
